questions.text: What is indicated about the lunch special?

options.A: It provides a choice for the main dish.
options.B: It is not offered on Sundays.
options.C: Its price has not been determined.
options.D: It is offered starting at 10:00 A.M.

questions.explain: “Tofu or tuna” → khách được chọn món chính (đậu phụ hoặc cá ngừ). Giá đã ghi R 120.00 (C sai), giờ phục vụ từ 11:00 (D sai), không nhắc Chủ nhật (B sai).

items.title: Part 7 — Unit 9: Frank's Auto Repair feedback
items.subtitle: Translate the passage, choose an answer, and find the supporting evidence.

questions.text: What does the customer consider unimportant when choosing a repair service?

options.B: The respect shown by the employees
options.C: The experience of the company's mechanics
options.D: The price of the company's services

questions.explain: “Convenient Location” khoanh số 2 (gần “Not important”) → địa điểm không quan trọng. Thợ có kinh nghiệm khoanh 6, giá khoanh 5.

passage.text:
Frank's Auto Repair
112 Central Avenue
Customer Feedback Form

Your opinions are important to us. We will use the information collected in this survey to help improve our service. Please tell us how important each of the following factors is to you when you choose a business for automotive repair. Circle a number from 1-6.

(1 = Not important … 6 = Very important; the customer's circled number is shown in brackets)
Price: 1 2 3 4 (5) 6
Convenient Location: 1 (2) 3 4 5 6
Experienced Mechanics: 1 2 3 4 5 (6)
Courteous Office Staff: 1 2 3 (4) 5 6

Did our staff:
Clearly explain the work your vehicle needed? — No: X
Treat you politely and with respect? — Yes: X
Accurately estimate the amount of time the work would take? — Yes: X
Tell you the cost before repairing your vehicle? — Yes: X

Comments
I'm not sure I understand what was wrong with the car, but the mechanics were able to fix it quickly and easily. The price was reasonable, too. But it would be helpful next if I could get more information about the repair.

questions.vi:
Tiệm sửa ô tô Frank
Số 112 đại lộ Central
Phiếu ý kiến khách hàng

Ý kiến của quý khách rất quan trọng với chúng tôi. Chúng tôi sẽ dùng thông tin thu được từ khảo sát này để cải thiện dịch vụ. Vui lòng cho biết mỗi yếu tố sau quan trọng thế nào với quý khách khi chọn nơi sửa ô tô. Khoanh một số từ 1 đến 6.

(1 = Không quan trọng … 6 = Rất quan trọng; số khách khoanh nằm trong ngoặc)
Giá cả: 1 2 3 4 (5) 6
Địa điểm thuận tiện: 1 (2) 3 4 5 6
Thợ máy có kinh nghiệm: 1 2 3 4 5 (6)
Nhân viên văn phòng lịch sự: 1 2 3 (4) 5 6

Nhân viên của chúng tôi có:
Giải thích rõ xe của quý khách cần sửa gì không? — Không: X
Đối xử lịch sự và tôn trọng với quý khách không? — Có: X
Ước tính chính xác thời gian sửa không? — Có: X
Báo giá trước khi sửa xe không? — Có: X

Nhận xét
Tôi không chắc mình hiểu xe bị hỏng gì, nhưng các thợ đã sửa nhanh và dễ dàng. Giá cũng hợp lý. Nhưng lần sau sẽ hữu ích hơn nếu tôi được biết thêm thông tin về việc sửa chữa.

questions.text: With which aspect of the service was the customer NOT satisfied?

options.A: The cost of the necessary parts
options.B: The amount of information given about the repair work
options.C: The amount of time needed to make the repairs

questions.explain: “Clearly explain the work your vehicle needed? No X” và “it would be helpful next if I could get more information about the repair” → không hài lòng về lượng thông tin.

items.title: Part 7 — Unit 9: Greenville road closures
items.subtitle: Translate the passage, choose an answer, and find the supporting evidence.

questions.text: What is the main reason for the road closures?
questions.explain: Cột Reason: “Ditch grading”, “Railroad crossing repair”, “Repave”, “Road improvements” → đều là công việc bảo trì/sửa đường theo kế hoạch.

passage.text:
The Greenville Department of Transportation
Reported Road Closures For County Roads in Greenville
August 4-18

Route 5 — From/To: South Avenue / Park Lane — Reason: Ditch grading & median expansion — Date: Aug. 4-10 — Alternate route: Martin Street to Maltby Road to Park Lane
Virginia Road — From/To: Valley Boulevard / Lakewood Drive — Reason: Railroad crossing repair — Date: Aug. 6-11 — Alternate route: Valley Boulevard to Baxter Street to Lakewood Drive
Serlin Boulevard (only northbound lanes unavailable) — From/To: Commerce Drive / Main Street — Reason: Repave northbound lanes — Date: Aug. 8-16 — Alternate route: Hartley Drive to Caxsen Way to Main Street
Adams Street — From/To: Ocean Road / Exchange Street — Reason: Road improvements (curb & gutter installation) — Date: Aug. 10-18 — Alternate route: Ocean Road to River Drive to Exchange Street

questions.vi:
Sở Giao thông Greenville
Thông báo đóng đường các tuyến đường hạt ở Greenville
Từ 4 đến 18 tháng 8

Route 5 — Đoạn: đại lộ South / Park Lane — Lý do: san mương và mở rộng dải phân cách — Thời gian: 4–10/8 — Đường thay thế: phố Martin sang đường Maltby sang Park Lane
Đường Virginia — Đoạn: đại lộ Valley / Lakewood Drive — Lý do: sửa chỗ giao cắt đường sắt — Thời gian: 6–11/8 — Đường thay thế: đại lộ Valley sang phố Baxter sang Lakewood Drive
Đại lộ Serlin (chỉ đóng các làn chiều đi lên phía bắc) — Đoạn: Commerce Drive / phố Main — Lý do: trải lại mặt các làn đi lên phía bắc — Thời gian: 8–16/8 — Đường thay thế: Hartley Drive sang Caxsen Way sang phố Main

passage.text:
Thank you for choosing Passages Hotel, Kuala Lumpur's premier hotel and conference center. We greatly value your opinion. Please take a moment to fill out the questionnaire and either leave it in your room or place it in the box located in the hotel's lobby.

Rate the following. (Excellent / Good / Fair / Poor / Not Used)
Front desk service — Poor
Concierge service — Excellent
Lotus restaurant — Excellent
Room service — Not Used
Housekeeping — Good
Business center — Good
Overall appearance of hotel — Excellent

I have stayed at this hotel a number of times on business and am usually very satisfied. However, this time it seemed that the front desk was understaffed the entire time I stayed here. I had to wait for 20 minutes to check in, and it took over 30 minutes to check out. In addition, it was difficult to contact the front desk from my room. Twice the phone rang without anyone picking up. I realize this was a busy month for the hotel, but enough staff should have been put on duty to accommodate guests.

Name (optional): Bindi Shah
Contact information (optional): bshah@svpnet.com
Date of stay: April 15-18
Passages Hotel

items.subtitle: Translate the passage, choose an answer, and find the supporting evidence.

questions.text: Where would the table probably be found?

options.A: In the catalog of a camera shop
options.D: In a magazine that reviews products

questions.explain: “Consumer Corner Monthly's Editor Review” và “published in every issue of the magazine are independent reviews” → tạp chí đánh giá sản phẩm.

passage.text:
Consumer Corner Monthly's Editor Review of 4 Selected Models of PILLAI digital cameras

Pillai GQ320
Comments: Very user-friendly with an intuitive menu. Comes with extra memory cards and a free set of rechargeable batteries.
Negatives: Very heavy for a camera this size.
Price: $250*

Pillai GG210
Comments: Essentially a GQ320 with fewer features. Strictly for use in interior spaces; does not handle outdoor photography well. Tolerates increased humidity.
Built-in: Built-in flash activates automatically in darkness.
Negatives: Picture quality compromised by low memory space.
Price: $150*

Pillai FZ200
Comments: Lightweight. Waterproof, for use at depths of up to 60 m.
Built-in: Features a Scubasonic sound system audible in submersed environments.
Negatives: Picture quality inferior to FV240.
Price: $650*

Pillai FV240
Comments: Record-high resolution, excellent image sharpness and clarity. The best in the under-$500 price range.
Price: $430*

* Prices shown are available at HY Stores. Because prices tend to vary from retailer to retailer, they may be different at Galactronic and Bisco Q, as well as in online stores such as PO Comp. Consumer Corner product tables published in every issue of the magazine are independent reviews by Consumer Corner's editors and are not part of the advertising supplements included every two months in Consumer Corner.

Pillai GQ320
Nhận xét: Rất dễ dùng, menu trực quan. Đi kèm thẻ nhớ dự phòng và một bộ pin sạc miễn phí.
